base: The PostgreSQL payment worker deadlocked because two transactions locked the account and invoice rows in opposite orders. I reproduced the cycle using concurrent transfers, changed both paths to lock the account first, and verified that concurrent transfers commit while preserving the ledger balance.

distinct: The SwiftUI sessions screen froze when switching tabs because a VStack constructed thousands of offscreen rows. I replaced it with a lazy container, retained stable row identity, and measured view creation while scrolling. Only visible rows were created and keyboard navigation still worked.
distinct_same_domain: The PostgreSQL report query stopped using its index after a new filter was added. EXPLAIN showed a sequential scan over every invoice because the predicate cast the timestamp column to text. I rewrote the predicate as a timestamp range, checked the execution plan, and measured reduced buffer reads. An integration test compares results at the time-zone boundary.

base: The DNS resolver returned stale addresses after a service migration. Packet capture showed that the authoritative nameserver published a one-hour TTL while our integration expected a minute. I reduced the record lifetime, waited for cached entries to expire, and verified resolution from independent recursive resolvers.

distinct: The image classifier failed on dark photographs because training examples had all been taken in daylight. I collected independently labeled low-light samples, stratified evaluation by illumination, and compared augmentation policies. Exposure augmentation improved recall without changing the held-out bright-image precision.
distinct_same_domain: The DNS deployment failed to authenticate zone transfers from the secondary nameserver. Logs showed that the configured TSIG key name differed between primary and secondary servers. I synchronized the key identifiers without exposing the secret, retried the signed transfer, and verified that unsigned requests remained denied and updated records reached the secondary.

base: The Rust archive extractor allowed a parent-directory path to escape the destination. I added fixtures containing traversal components and absolute paths, rejected unsafe names before opening output files, and verified that valid nested files still extract. The regression confirms no file is written outside the temporary extraction root.

distinct: The greenhouse irrigation controller watered plants twice after a power interruption. I traced the failure to a volatile schedule cursor, persisted completed watering events with monotonic identifiers, and simulated restart at every transaction boundary. Each scheduled watering now occurs once and soil moisture remains within the target band.
distinct_same_domain: The Rust archive compression job consumed excessive memory on large files. Profiling showed that the code loaded each input completely before compression. I changed the encoder to read bounded buffers from a streaming reader and verified round-trip bytes across empty, small, and multi-gigabyte files. Peak allocation stayed bounded independently of input size.
